scope: Desktop isolated offscreen correctness and experiment configuration, not formal unlocked-clock performance results
surface: Offscreen BGRA8 1333x600; hidden window used only to initialize VulkanContext; no WSI presents inside the benchmark

timing_method.readback: after completed submission, outside timestamp interval

variants.B_default: separate lightweight generated-source shader, unchanged blend equations and draws
variants.B_indexed: same shaders, four unique vertices and static uint32 indices; prototype backend compaction only

provenance_note: Raw archive contains a measured-source snapshot for the indexed runs and later generated-source runs. Earlier generated-source prototype EXEs were not individually hashed before replacement. Final source changes only replace fixture unique ownership with explicit raw ownership and were revalidated; timing binaries are retained in the raw archive. Do not treat all raw runs as one byte-identical executable.
limitations: Synthetic sprites; not the endless gameplay workload.
Desktop results cannot establish Adreno performance or energy use.
Indexed prototype adds host compaction work; production requires four vertices at call sites.
Rejected merged-blend experiment failed the pixel gate and was not timed.
Full WSI validation still reports PRESENT_AFTER_WRITE; root cause is not established.
Experimental controls/timing code compile only in the opt-in library.
